highlights: Downloads manager in the shell, with a live taskbar and system tray.
The 60 Hz refresh-rate cap is now a setting you can change.
The audio visualiser draws its spectrum in one Canvas and no longer re-evaluates bindings per audio frame.

sections.title: Shell
items: Downloads surface, a decorative-motion budget, and a live taskbar/tray.
Popout drawers no longer shift colour while closing, and the 21 px blur overflow is gone.

sections.title: Performance
items: Audio data no longer re-evaluates bindings on every stream frame.
Metric-driven motion moved to the decorative clock.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Window identity resolves in one place, so every source carries icons.
Media deduplication no longer deletes the Firefox player.
